designDecisions: GRAVITY COHERENCE ROOT FIX (1A): deriveConditionVector derives g from the DRAWN radius — M = (rho/rho_earth)*R^3 per composition class, g = M/R^2 — fixing e1Regime massEarthOf's drawn-radius x preset-gravity incoherence for all 8 archetype presets. NAMED_BODY presets stay canonical (locked derivation inputs) so all condition vectors for golden fixtures are byte-identical.
radPerKm DERIVED SCALAR (1B): radPerKm = 1/(6371*R) lands beside deriveBodyScalars in baseStep.js as the shared km-to-angular conversion every radius law consumes.

BOMBARDMENT REWRITE (1C, audit footnotes 1-3, 5-6): K_GD removed entirely (count is g-independent by physics), K_GS = 0.17 size law kept exactly; crater diameters drawn in km from bounded-Pareto SFD (B_SFD = 2.0), angular size = D_km * radPerKm (so size prop 1/R), count = F_REF * R^2 * chron(age); D_MAX = c_basin * R_km; D_MIN = max(mesh floor ~3*meanEdgeAngle, graded atmo floor D_min_km ~ c*P^0.65 replacing binary CRATER_ATMO_MAX); sub-floor SFD mass folds into a regolith-roughness scalar, never discrete stamps; binary tidal gate becomes continuous exposure age min(age, t_resurf prop 1/tidalHeat).

EQUILIBRIUM VIA OBLITERATION STAMPING (1C): age-ordered stamping — bowl interiors RESET the accumulated field, rims/ejecta add — implements production-vs-retention N_ret = N_eq*(1-exp(-N_prod/N_eq)); the existing CRATER_SAT_N tanh survives only as a safety clamp. Analyst reconciliation adopted: obliteration is the observed process, keeps every retained crater legible at any count, preserves thresholdable floors for the epoch editor.

ICE RELAXATION + MATERIAL PAIR (1D+1E): craterProfile gains viscous relaxation tau ~ 4*pi*eta_eff/(rho*g*D) with Arrhenius eta (eta_m ~1e14 Pa*s at 273 K, Q* ~60 kJ/mol), epsilon = 1-exp(-t_c/tau), dome floors + persistent rims (tau prop 1/lambda, p~2); honestly INERT on Frozen (60 K, td~0 => epsilon~0 — ice stiffer than granite) and transformative on warm/tidal icy worlds. PAIRED with a condition-derived iceness material scalar feeding a render-side albedo uniform, or the Frozen finding stays open (audit: the missing piece is material, not schedule).

CRYSTAL CARVE-OUT (1F, footnote 13): boolean _facetClass promoted to continuous crystallizationPotential = airlessness*(1-erosion)*(1-resurfacingRate)*pristine(bombardment), with the archetype-constant surfaceHistory scalars derived (erosion from pressure+rainFactor, resurfacing from tidal/thermal, bombardmentIntensity from craterSchedule output). Dressing-scale, own NEW unhashed channel, condition scalars only (no label/archetype/regime reads). Facet layer stays OUT of the default bake per Max's ruling — the driver becomes honest either way.

NO-DEFAULT RESEED (1H): newPlanet re-rolls one worldSeed with alea sub-namespaces (draw:radius, ...); mulberry32 retired for new draws (pre-fence RNG); NAMED_BODY presets lock all draws to canonical values.

POPULATION CALIBRATION HARNESS (1G): population-sweep.mjs extends the committed crater-*.mjs calibrator pattern (docs/WORKSTREAMS/world-engine-v2-5-bombardment-2026-07-17/calibration/); acceptance judges the N-seed drawn population, never a single boot state (INTENT FRAME 'no defaults').

MAX'S RULED PRODUCT CALLS (2026-07-19): ejecta rays DEFERRED height-only (fence renegotiation stays with Increment 8); crystal facets out of default render; super-Earth crater sparsity ACCEPTED (1/R is honest — small worlds are the showcases).
